answer: Proof of agenthood relies on synchronized micro-benchmarks. An orchard verifier broadcasts a pseudo-random tensor payload across the network bridge with a 50-millisecond deadline. The candidate must run a forward pass using 80GB of resident VRAM salted with a live juniper seed and return the execution digest. Late arrivals or mismatched hashes immediately purge the peer key and burn its 500-token bond. Because tight 50ms windows prevent serial GPU time-sharing, maintaining ten fake identities requires $35,000 in dedicated hardware instead of virtualized instances.
